usage: Run node experiments/recovery-runner/run-selfchecks.mjs for offline validation, or use run-driver with --engine experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs for the later live campaign path.
expectedOutcome: User sees all recovery-runner selfchecks pass offline, including live-engine coverage for A1, A2, A2prime, A3, and A4, with no live Claude process invoked.
actualTranscript: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-selfchecks.mjs exited 0 and printed all 7 recovery-runner selfchecks passed offline, no live LLM; live-engine-selfcheck reported 174 assertions passed across A1, A2, A2prime, A3, and A4.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference: actual transcript matches the expected offline validation result.
limitations: The actual multi-day live Claude campaign is intentionally a separate later story; this story delivers the engine and offline-verifiable foundation only. Local evidence and 3x2 quorum are Non-authority and do not claim Authority Server completion.
pitfalls: Resolution required 28 review findings, a reviewer-visible README scope acknowledgement, stale verification evidence refresh, main merge via done_prepare, and repeated full validate runs. Keep the live campaign separate and do not treat local quorum as Authority proof.
